answer: Cosignatures are collected in prism, verified in ridge, and karst names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 49 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, so that paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 5 times costs 44 separate deposits and 28 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
